content.text: No minimum commitment or volume restriction exists; the deal is a non-exclusive revenue-share with no fees payable by AP. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, minimum spend, minimum impression/volume obligation or take-or-pay on AP. Section 5 (Fees and Payment, p0023) is a pure revenue-share: Kubient contracts with Advertisers and remits AP's share within seven days of receipt, with no fees payable by AP other than applicable transaction taxes. Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP may offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, so there is no volume cap or channel restriction on us either. The only "minimum" references are the Customer-set floor price in the "Winning Bid Price" definition (p0014), which benefits AP, and Kubient's disclaimer of any guaranteed minimum revenue (p0062) — neither is a commitment binding AP. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; consideration flows from actual monetized usage). Noted but not flagged under this rule: the Initial Term is one year with no convenience termination during that period, and Kubient retains fees generated during a termination notice period (p0016) — a term/termination point rather than a purchase commitment, since no spend obligation attaches.
